retainedAttempts.reason: Two detached-row evaluations supplied multiple statements to an expression evaluator. Only the new producer was corrected with IIFEs. Original JSON and five PNGs remain; original stdout was overwritten by a duplicate-output root retry, explicitly recorded by browser-initial-provenance.json and not reconstructed.

An unselected reference is correctly rejected by bridge DTO membership with studio_core_request_invalid. The new smoke expected the native error family; only the exact assertion was corrected, retaining mandatory rejection. Original producer, JSON, five PNGs and log remain.

limits: All work and verification occur in an isolated /tmp source copy. This report grants no installation, author-data or actual-checkout write authority.
Positions are set to the reference original coordinate along an explicit authored X/Y/Z component. This is not screen, rotated box-edge, AABB, layout-distribution or camera alignment.
No objects or reference are implicitly selected. Search hides list rows only; global selected and reference UUIDs remain explicit. Removing the reference requires the user to choose another one.

Original private proposals reach the injected memory-application port unchanged; the controller imports no renderer, sibling author form, World, backend or Save capability. Ordinary Save remains the source editor responsibility.

Native no-op, stale source/raw intent/late owner, obsolete row callbacks and forged receipts cannot authorize application. Full/core/UI/prepared/browser scopes overlap and are not summed as unique coverage.
